package.name: g1_courier_sim
package.description: Sim-only nodes for G1 Courier. Two parts: - Linux helper nodes (sim_cmd_vel_bridge for kinematic /odom integration, fake action stubs for Phase 0 tests, nav2_navigate_proxy adapter). - sim_bridge/ — bundled MuJoCo bridge for Ubuntu native sim path (Option C). Requires Python deps: mujoco, unitree_sdk2py, pupil-apriltags, pygame, opencv-python (pip install). Plus G1 mesh STL files from upstream unitree_mujoco — see docs/sim_setup_ubuntu.md.
